rules.name: Hitomi
rules.comment: Mirrors ComicRead's hitomi adapter (hymbz/ComicReadScript src/site/hitomi.tsx): gallery and reader pages both load galleries/<id>.js into window.galleryinfo; page URLs come from the site's own url_from_url_from_hash(id, file, 'webp'). The reader page loads galleryinfo asynchronously, hence detect/images wait for it.
rules.detect:
var g = window.galleryinfo;
return !!(g && Array.isArray(g.files) && g.files.length > 0 && g.type !== 'anime');
